name: Universidad Peruana de Ciencias Aplicadas
overview:
Additional Programme Requirements


Students must demonstrate a B1 level in Spanish via an interview with a Spanish speaker in order to be eligible for this destination (organized by IAFF team)


_____________________________________________________________________________


Universidad Peruana de Ciencias Aplicadas

Universidad Peruana Ciencias Aplicadas is a large private university located in Lima, Peru. They have around 80,000 students enrolled in approximately 46 different programs or majors.

The Universidad Peruana de Ciencias Aplicadas has a main campus in Santiago de Surco, Lima, Peru. It is known as el Campus Monterrico, which has a size of 3 hectares.

Lima, the capital of Peru, lies on the country's arid Pacific coast. Though its colonial center is preserved, it's a bustling metropolis and one of South America’s largest cities. It's home to the Museo Larco collection of pre-Columbian art and the Museo de la Nación, tracing the history of Peru’s ancient civilizations. The Plaza de Armas and the 16th-century cathedral are the heart of old Lima Centro.
administrative:
1. Application Dossier

You will work directly with the partner university regarding your application. All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline. (See the Americas Teams channel for each application deadline.)

If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet — please be patient.


To be given to the Epitech bachelor campus administration to reenroll for Tech4 (in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier


Note: This information is subject to change by the partner university. They will provide you with the most current details upon your acceptance.


2. Visa application

For an exchange student visa application at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Peru, the student will typically need to present the following documents:

  • Valid passport
  • Proof of financial means (bank statements of the financial sponsors with a minimum of USD 3,200 per semester)
  • Health insurance certificate
  • Flight Itinerary or travel plan
  • Passport-sized photos


Exchange students must confirm in advance the Peruvian Consulate where they will pick up their visa. Find a Peruvian Consulate here: https://www.consulado.pe/paginas/Inicio.aspx


You can also arrive in Peru as a tourist but after 90 days, you are legally required to change your status from tourist to student (also known as "Calidad Migratoria de Formacion"). You must begin the process within your first few weeks in Peru, ideally within 30 days of arrival. If you wait too long, you could lose the chance to apply or need to pay fines.


Before applying for the process, make sure you have:

  • Valid passport and copy of Bio page & Latest Peruvian entry stamp
  • Acceptance letter from Universidad Peruana de Ciencias Aplicadas
  • Completed application form (F-004), signed.
  • Criminal background certificate from your home country (apostilled and translated if needed).
  • Ficha de Canje Internacional INTERPOL
  • Health insurance certificate
  • Proof of financial solvency (e.g., bank statement or scholarship letter)

Note: Any documents not in Spanish must be translated by an official translator in Peru.

Insurance and Health


It is imperative that you take out an international insurance that will cover you for your medical and hospital expenses, repatriation and accompanied by civil liability.

International insurance must cover the entire period of your studies in the country. Insurance costs are the responsibility of each student. 


To take out international insurance, the market is quite open. Please click here for more information. 


For more information, you can consult the country's health file at: https://www.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fr/conseils-aux-voyageurs/conseils-par-pays-destination/perou/


Note: It is advisable to register on the French register established outside of France and to report to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs via the Ariane platform: https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html

courses:
Credits

Students should take 15 local credits per semester (30 total) for a total of 60 ECTS.


At UPC, courses are usually worth 3 to 4 credits. Rough conversion to ECTS: 1 UPC credit = 2 ECTS


Academic Calendar

  • Semester 1: Mid-August to beginning of December
  • Semester 2: Mid-March to beginning of July


Department and Courses

Students may take a mix of courses in Spanish and English. At least 2/3 of the curriculum must be in IT.


Since IT courses in English are limited, students will likely need to take some courses in Spanish.


Course syllabi will be sent via email. Applicants must indicate the UPC program, course name, and UPC code.


Once the online course registration process is completed, no changes can be made. Withdrawals or changes (including schedule modifications) are free of charge during the first 6 weeks from the start of classes. Learning agreements sent after this period will be evaluated and possibly rejected.


The International Office team in Peru will schedule mandatory follow-up meetings every two weeks for international students.

The grading scale in Peru runs from 0 to 20, with 20 being the maximum score. The passing grade in Peru is 11, but at UPC it is set at 13 to ensure academic exigency.

UPC will issue official academic transcripts roughly one month after the end of classes. Transcripts will be sent via email in digital format to the International Office of the foreign institution.


Important Notes

  • Presence in class is compulsory, under penalty of loss of visa and repatriation to France at the student's expense (impact on credits).
  • The courses are most likely more academic than at EPITECH.
  • The course list is given for information only. It can change from year to year.
  • If a course is not available when you arrive on site, EPITECH cannot be held responsible for it.
  • Any Tech 4 abroad involves an EIP! Take advantage of the free slots you will have to advance it.
cost:
Financial Overview (4th Year EPITECH)

  • You must pay the tuition fees for the 4th year of EPITECH, as well as the re-registration fees and related fees.
  • EPITECH covers the application fees and part of the tuition fees.
  • The tuition supplement payable by you is indicated at the top of this page (if applicable).
  • Other costs at your expense include: travel, accommodation on site, insurance, and everyday expenses (books, food, transport, etc.).


Other Expenses

  • Roundtrip flights: about 1000€ depending on the airline & travel dates
  • Insurance: 300-600€ depending on the company and the coverage
  • Visa


Estimated monthly budget

The local currency is the Sol. 1 € = 3.94PEN (rate as of October 2025).

Please check the Numbeo website to compare the cost of living between your city of origin and your city of exchange. Please note that everyone's budget will be different according to one's lifestyle.

Estimated total: 500-1000$/month, excluding rent

  • Housing (share apartment or student residence) $300-450
  • Food $180-230
  • Transportation $40-100
